items.title: JQ514 MEL T4 → SYD T2
items.note: Scheduled to land ~2:25pm. Check the Jetstar app for the gate and time.

items.title: Train T8 to Wynyard (no change)
items.note:
Tap card/phone. Includes the ~$18.61 airport station fee.
Then Wynyard Walk to Barangaroo, ~7 min.

items.title: Barangaroo foreshore walk
items.note: Wulugul Walk to the headland, ~30 min.

items.title: Work: State Library of NSW
items.place: State Library of NSW, Macquarie St
items.note:
Reading rooms open till 8pm Mon–Thu, free wifi.
Metro Barangaroo → Martin Place, 1 stop.
Most CBD cafés close 3–4pm.

items.title: Train to Burwood (~20–25 min)
items.note:
From Town Hall or Wynyard. Pick a train that stops at Burwood.
Drop the bag at the hotel.

items.title: Dinner with friend: Burwood Chinatown
items.note:
Hawker-style: Lovin' Lamb skewers, 1915 Lanzhou noodles.
If the friend wants the city: Haymarket Chinatown, then train back.

items.title: The Park Oasis Burwood
items.note:
Check-in from 3–4pm. Message them about late arrival.
6 min walk from Burwood Station. Check-out Fri 11am.

items.title: Check out, ask them to hold the bag
items.note: Burwood is 1 stop from Strathfield: grab it Sat on the way to the concert (or Fri evening).

items.title: Breakfast in the city
items.note: Or HK breakfast at Kowloon Cafe Burwood before you leave.

items.title: Lunch with her: Cantonese / dim sum
items.note:
Book. Lunch from noon.
Walk-in plan B: Marigold, Haymarket (trolley yum cha).

items.title: Her bakery (TBC)
items.note: Send the name; moves to Sat morning if it's out of the way.

items.title: Sculpture by the Sea: Bondi → Tamarama
items.note:
Free, on until 2 Nov. T4 to Bondi Junction + bus 333.
~2 km, about an hour with the sculptures. Sunset ~7:20pm.
Rain plan: Art Gallery of NSW + Botanic Garden.

items.title: Dinner: Korean pocha
items.place: Hongdae Pocha, 5 Central Park Ave, Chippendale
items.note:
Seoul street-food bar by Central.
Or Chinatown Friday Night Market, Dixon St.

items.title: Optional: Luna Park Halloscream
items.note: 29–31 Oct, ticketed. Train to Milsons Point.

items.title: Manly ferry + beach
items.note:
30 min each way, best harbour view for a ferry fare.
Alt: The Rocks Markets + walk the Harbour Bridge.
Back in the city by 2:30pm.

items.title: Train to Strathfield (~15 min from Central)
items.note:
Grab the bag from Burwood if it's there.
Trackwork on 31 Oct: check Trip Planner.

items.title: Early Korean dinner, Strathfield
items.note:
Myeong Dong (kalguksu), Red Pepper (fried chicken, in a club: bring ID), Jomaru hot pot.
Beat the 5:30pm queues.

items.title: Event train/bus to Olympic Park
items.note:
Free with the concert ticket.
Station → stadium ~10 min walk.

items.title: BIGBANG: XX : COSMOS
items.note:
Gates 5pm, show 7:30pm. Merch queues: go earlier if it matters.
After: event trains home (free); expect a 30–60 min wait.

items.title: Weekend yum cha, then the airport
items.note:
Trolley yum cha, 5 min walk to Central for the airport train.
Or Mr Wong (weekend yum cha, book). Bring your bags.

items.title: Train T8 to Domestic Airport (~15 min)
items.note:
Airport station fee again (~$18.61).
Sunday trackwork: check Trip Planner.

items.title: JQ615 SYD T2 → Melbourne
items.note:
Be at T2 by 12:45pm: bag drop closes 1:20pm (40 min before), gate 1:40pm (20 min).
Check the booking: Jetstar's JQ6xx Sydney flights often land at Avalon, not Tullamarine.
